name: USDA NASS Quick Stats: US Agricultural Statistics Database
description: USDA NASS Quick Stats is the official, comprehensive public statistical repository of United States agricultural data maintained by the USDA National Agricultural Statistics Service. Housing over 50 million historical and current data points dating from 1850 to the present, Quick Stats aggregates information from hundreds of annual sample surveys and the 5-year Census of Agriculture covering crop acreage, yields, production, livestock counts, prices, farm labor, and environmental practices down to state and county levels.
